Supported operations:
• Arithmetic: +, -, *, /, ^ (integer, half-integer, and general rational exponents), abs, max, min
• Transcendentals: Real.sin, Real.cos, Real.exp, Real.log,
Real.sqrt, Real.arctan, Real.arsinh, Real.atanh,
Real.sinc, Real.erf, Real.sinh, Real.cosh, Real.tanh
• Constants: rational numbers, Real.pi, Real.eulerMascheroniConstant

Suggestions:
• Normalize first with `interval_norm`
• Unfold custom definitions with `simp only [myDef]`
• Add a handler for the head symbol above if this form should be supported
